Path of War Subscription

Vendor: Dreamscarred Press
Type: Book
Price: 14.99

Complete Path of War Bundle - Save on All 4 Releases

Make martial combat more interesting with Path of War, a revolutionary maneuver-based combat system designed and playtested to work side-by-side with all standard Pathfinder RPG classes. This subscription bundle includes all four Path of War releases for a total of $14.99 - a significant savings over purchasing individually at $7.99 each.

Complete Bundle Includes:

The Stalker: Tireless warrior with precognitive battle understanding, complete maneuver combat system, five martial disciplines with hundreds of strikes, counters, boosts and stances, plus new feats
The Warder: The shield that stops the horde - guardian base class with four martial disciplines, defensive maneuvers, and the complete maneuver combat system
The Warlord: Inspiring battlefield leader with tactical maneuvers, five martial disciplines, and abilities that aid allies through incredible daring
The Harbinger: Supernatural martial combat with two new martial disciplines, archetypes, and 9 new feats mixing mysticism with martial prowess
Bonus: Supplemental Content with archetypes including soulhunter, dervish defender, and steelfist commando

What is Path of War:

Path of War transforms martial combat from repetitive "I attack again" into dynamic, tactical gameplay with maneuvers, stances, and special abilities that rival spellcasters. The system introduces strikes (offensive maneuvers), counters (defensive reactions), boosts (self-enhancements), and stances (sustained combat modes) across multiple martial disciplines.

Why This Bundle:

Save $17.97 - get all 4 releases for $14.99 instead of $31.96
Complete maneuver combat system with multiple base classes
Dozens of martial disciplines to customize your warrior
Hundreds of maneuvers, stances, and tactical options
Balanced to work alongside standard Pathfinder classes
Playtested for seamless integration

Perfect For:

Players tired of repetitive martial combat
GMs seeking to balance martials with casters
Groups wanting tactical depth in melee combat
Pathfinder campaigns needing fresh martial options

Expand Your Martial Arsenal:

Want even more? Check out Path of War: Expanded for additional classes and disciplines. Browse all Dreamscarred Press products or explore more Pathfinder supplements.

Digital PDF bundle by Dreamscarred Press for Pathfinder RPG. Includes The Stalker, The Warder, The Warlord, The Harbinger, and Supplemental Content.

Ultimate Psionics Print Only

Vendor: Dreamscarred Press
Type: Book
Price: 52.46 - 89.95 (4 variants)

This is a variant of Ultimate Psionics used in special offers. Unless you've received communication directing you to this product you PROBABLY want this one instead!

The long-awaited Ultimate Psionics IS NOW HERE! Ultimate Psionics combines the material found in Psionics Unleashed and Psionics Expanded, plus a multitude of brand new character options, new psionic races, gamemaster advice, and exciting variant options to make psionics fit into any game or campaign setting. Included are stunning artwork scenes depicting the iconic psionic characters.

Including cover art by Wayne Reynolds, Ultimate Psionics adds ten psionic base classes, over a dozen psionic prestige classes, hundreds of psionic powers, scores of psionic feats, pages and pages of psionic items and equipment, and even helpful tips on how to change the theme of psionics to fit into your game without changing the actual rules, with an example describing how to change psionics into rune magic.

Ultimate Psionics is 451 jam-packed pages of psionic material for both GMs and players which was publicly playtested by players all over the world! This is the book you need for all things psionic!

Included in the book you will find:

Ten psionic races - including the brand new forgeborn and noral
Ten psionic base classes - the aegis, cryptic, dread, marksman, psion, psychic warrior, soulknife, tactician, vitalist, and wilder
The Autohypnosis and Knowledge (psionics) skills
Dozens of psionic and metapsionic feats
Hundreds of psionic powers
Nineteen psionic prestige classes, including the cerebremancer, metamind, body snatcher, and sighted seeker
Psionic items including psionic tattoos, dorjes, psicrowns, psicrystal staves, torcs, and even legendary items!
A section dedicated to helping Game Masters run psionics in their games
Instructions on how to change the theme of psionics to fit any campaign, even giving specific changes to make to turn psionics into "rune magic."

And much, much more!
